facts.fact: The document states that the Government of Mali adopted the telecommunications sector policy declaration (Declaration de Politique Sectorielle des Telecommunications) in 2000, setting the country's telecom objectives and action programme.
facts.system: Declaration de politique sectorielle des telecommunications du Mali (DPST)

facts.fact: The document states that the Government adopted a national information and communication technology policy in 2005, built on six priorities: legal framework, infrastructure, content and applications, media, cooperation and financing.
facts.system: Politique nationale des technologies de l'information et de la communication
